intro.text: Lord Stanton, head of a noble house in Elendel.

items.text: Soon after coming back from the Roughs, Wax went to a party Lord Stanton held but slipped away to roam the mists rather than mingle, a slight he later apologized for by letter. That night and others like it, including one at Lady Aving Cett's party, earned Wax a name for wildness and bad manners.
